resources.string: Evens out loud and quiet parts automatically
Volume Leveling needs Android 9 (API 28) or newer and isn\'t available on this device.
Root access: not detected on this device

Root mode unlocks a higher loudness ceiling (up to +30 dB, may distort audio at high settings) and lets you force-restart the system audio service. Everything else in this app works fully without root.

This phone's launcher doesn't show the automatic add-widget dialog. Try one of these:

1. Pinch in on the home screen with two fingers, then choose Widgets.

2. Long-press the StarrySound icon on the home screen or app drawer, then choose Widgets.

3. Open phone Settings → Home screen and look for Widgets.

4. On Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO, Oppo, Vivo: open app permissions, enable "Home screen shortcuts", then try the add widget button again.

Add an AI API key (Gemini, OpenAI or Anthropic) in Settings to get AI music picks. Tap to open Settings.

Optional. Pick Gemini (free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey), OpenAI or Anthropic and paste your own API key for it. It powers the AI picks for you shelf on Home and AI playlists made from a typed request. Only artist and song names from your likes and history are sent, plus any text you type for an AI playlist, and only to the service you picked. OpenAI and Anthropic usage is billed to your own account; on the free Gemini tier Google may use the data to improve its products. Keys stay on this device (not backed up to Drive). The model field is optional: leave it empty for the default, or type another model name if the default stops working.
Spread the load over my AI keys

With keys for more than one service, requests are shared between them, and when one hits its limit the next takes over. The service you picked gets the biggest share. Off = only the picked service is used.
